# Assumption of Moses Chapter 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Taxo and His Sons: Martyrdom as Witness

---

**9:1** Then there will be a man of the tribe of Levi whose name is Taxo, who will have seven sons.

**9:2** And he will speak to them, saying: See, my sons, a second and cruel oppression and punishment have come upon the people, which is merciless and more severe than the first.

**9:3** Now listen to me, my sons, and hear what I have to say.

**9:4** Our fathers and their fathers tested God three times and endured the torment of their souls.

**9:5** But never before in the history of our people has one come who was so righteous and innocent as our fathers were.

**9:6** Let us now fast for a period of three days and on the fourth day enter a cave which is in the field, and we will die there rather than transgress the commandments of the Lord of lords, the God of our fathers.

**9:7** If we do this and die, our blood will be avenged before the Lord.

**9:8** For from our blood the Lord will take vengeance on those kings of the earth who have shed the blood of his saints.

**9:9** Then his kingdom shall appear throughout all his creation, and then Satan shall have an end, and sorrow shall be led away with him.

**9:10** Then the hands of the angel who is appointed the highest shall be filled, who has been appointed from the beginning, and he will at once avenge them of their enemies.
